verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two separate pieces: RUN's in-product AI error flagging that catches payroll mistakes, and API Central for HR data integration. Nothing documents an API that runs a payroll preview or returns flagged anomalies for an agent to review before approval. The error flagging is an adjacent in-app feature and API Central is only a generic developer building block, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run
